description: A repeated MANAGEMENT D_PDU (same frame ID) is acknowledged again but not acted on again; copies received while an acknowledgement is still queued add nothing.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). Every MANAGEMENT D_PDU here is type 6 from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.2, address size 4, EOT 10, VALID MESSAGE 1, ACK 0, frame ID 5, carrying EOW 0x158: ED3-BASIC-RATE (data rate 5, 2400 bps; interleaving 2, long; other parameters 0, a DRC request), an Ed3 stop/start data rate change request (C-0919). Burst 1, D_PDU at 2000 (end 7000): new (C-0315), so it is acknowledged and, as the procedure is not supported, refused with a WARNING reason 3, RECEIVED FRAME TYPE 6 (C-0920, C-0921, C-1071). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; 7000: rule 1, CONT_WAIT 45000 (first draw of seed 0, slot 15); 52000: the acknowledgement (type 6, ACK 1, VALID MESSAGE 0, frame ID 5, EOW 0) then the WARNING (type 15), both EOT 10, one block, duration 5550. Burst 2 at 67550, D_PDUs at 68550 (end 73550): two copies of the same frame. The first equals RX MANAGEMENT FRAME ID, so it is a repeat (C-0316, C-1016): acknowledged again (C-0296), no WARNING; the second finds that acknowledgement still queued and adds nothing (C-1074). Burst end 69550: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 73550 rule 1 again (the last transmission was received and addressed only to this node), CONT_WAIT with the second draw of seed 0, slot 4, 12000 ms; then one acknowledgement alone.
